criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Specific number contrast and a named tension in nine words over a GPU terrain with a gold cord; at 432 px the cord thins and the July loop runs off frame, and the ridge climbs behind '19,500.'.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: Credit then press; 02 pays the size at once, 05 breathes, 07 turns, 08 presses, 09 asks. 03 and 04 could swap; 06 could sit anywhere after 02; 08 repeats 05's no-specific-project line.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: GPU PBR on 01, 05, 09 with a real thin-lens depth frame on 05. 04's lifted plan relief smears; 07's SDF cord is lumpy and oversized with a blob of a hitch; 08's projected frame carries dark blotches; 03's cord is a flat stroke and its dashes clip white; 02, 06 and 08 share an oak-framed plan view.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Cord is the exact 170 cells of the legal description, July outline traced and labelled projected, hatch keyed to plat year, three wool strands for three AWC waters, four blocks for four things not authorized. 07's label reads backwards for a reversion; 08's blotches undercut 'nothing drawn'.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Houston, Haessler-Norris, the Little Susitna, three AWC numbers, Crowther, ADL 234762, plats of 1915/1917/1963, real Mat-Su terrain; credits the commenters before pressing. Houston label dropped from the art.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Each content slide adds a verified specific; 2,306 opens both 03 and 08 and C46 is spent twice.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: New hero, atmosphere, palette and hook archetype; still the fifth Houston deck and a terrain map with a gold boundary.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: 04 carries eight 22 px plates including the approximate note at worst-point 4.0; 02's rail labels outside the 80 px safe zone; 08 block labels wedged on the back edge.

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: 119-char definition-subversion hook, debatable closing question; 'leaves the water ... for later' can read against the 100 ft setback; paired 'DNR's reply is that' lines read mechanically.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Post copy, 3 hashtags, dated first-comment sources, title, aftercare and editor notes present; Gmail draft and merged URLs pending at scoring time.

calculation: (8x0.14)+(8x0.14)+(7x0.16)+(8.5x0.14)+(9x0.12)+(8x0.10)+(8x0.08)+(7x0.07)+(7.5x0.05)+(8x0.10) = 8.735 by the rubric's formula. The rubric's weights sum to 1.10, so normalized to unit weight the score is 7.94.
threshold_basis: iteration_ladder, revision_rounds 4+ (ship best version, flag shortfall in email)
one_sentence_fix: Re-render slide 04's main view through the shared akthree table scene, as round 5 did for 08's window: lit DEM relief with shadow-map casts instead of the smeared plan-oblique lift, the whole parcel inside the bed, and the 22 px plates raised to 24 px.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: akthree render of the parcel's south half with shadow-map casts, full cord inside the bed

editor_notes_for_email: Ships at round 5 of 5 against the 7.7 ladder threshold, no hard fails. 8.735 by the rubric's formula; the weights sum to 1.10, normalized 7.94, below the standard 8.3.
Art 7 under the 8.5 craft floor; no craft cycle possible at the cap. Weakest frames 04, 07, 08, 03.
The FFD says 19,500 on p.1, 'approximately 20,000' elsewhere and 19,950 in the WSWCD summary; earlier decks used 19,950. The vicinity map's GIS total is 6,749 acres against the decision's 6,800.
Reconsideration requests due November 30th (20 days), timely commenters only, $200, dnr.appeals@alaska.gov.
08 sets DNR's position in the Fraunces text cut without quote marks; 07's label can read backwards for a reversion.
Caption: 'leaves the water ... for later' means groundwater and wells, not the streams that got the setback.
The first comment (sources) must be pasted by hand.
